after.zh: 一轮两点都是内点的概率是 p²，k 轮全落空的概率是 (1 − p²)ᵏ。要成功率达到 P，就要 k ≥ log(1 − P) / log(1 − pⁿ)：p = 0.5、n = 2、P = 0.99 时是 17 轮，内点只剩 30% 时要 49 轮。轮数由内点比例决定，δ 由噪声决定，两者不能互相代替。
after.en: The chance that both points of a round are inliers is p², and the chance that all k rounds miss is (1 − p²)ᵏ. To reach a success rate P you need k ≥ log(1 − P) / log(1 − pⁿ): with p = 0.5, n = 2 and P = 0.99 that is 17 rounds, and with only 30% inliers it takes 49. The number of rounds is set by the inlier ratio and δ by the noise; neither can stand in for the other.

t.zh: 配对、找线时总会混进错的点，叫外点；对的点叫内点。用一条线去贴合所有点，几个离得远的外点就能把线拽歪。全景拼接、车道识别都要先对付它们。
t.en: When matching points or finding lines, wrong points always creep in; these are called outliers, and the right ones inliers. If you fit one line to all the points, a few far-off outliers can drag it askew. Panorama stitching and lane detection both have to deal with them first.

t.zh: RANSAC 换了个思路：随机抽两个点连成线，数有多少点离它够近，算作支持；反复抽很多轮，留下支持最多的那条。
t.en: RANSAC takes a different approach: pick two points at random and join them with a line, then count how many points lie close enough to it to count as support. Repeat for many rounds and keep the line with the most support.

caption.zh: RANSAC 钉板：每轮抽两根钉，落在导轨之间的钉投票
caption.en: RANSAC pegboard: each round draws two pegs, and the pegs between the rails vote

t.zh: 台上要定两个数：抽几轮 k，以及离线多近才算支持 δ。每种设置都会跑 200 次试验，看找对的比例。外点比例有三种，每种的轮数都有上限。
t.en: On the bench you set two numbers: the number of rounds k, and δ, how close to the line a point must be to count as support. Each setting is run for 200 trials to see how often it finds the right line. There are three outlier ratios, and each has a cap on the number of rounds.

t.zh: 这一关你要为三种外点比例各选一个 k，再选一个共用的 δ，让成功率都达到 99%。要想的是：外点越多，轮数该怎样变？δ 又该由什么决定？
t.en: In this level you choose a k for each of the three outlier ratios, plus one shared δ, so that every success rate reaches 99%. The questions are: as outliers increase, how should the number of rounds change? And what should decide δ?

brief.zh: 每轮随机抽 2 个点连成直线，数离它不到 δ 的点，k 轮后留下支持最多的一条。三种外点比例下，各用不超过预算的 k，让 200 次试验的成功率都 ≥ 99%。
brief.en: Each round draws 2 random points, joins them into a line and counts the points closer than δ to it; after k rounds the line with the most support is kept. For each of the three outlier ratios, use a k within the budget so that the success rate over 200 trials is ≥ 99%.

hint.zh: 外点越多，一轮抽中两个内点的机会越小。δ 只和噪声有关：太小漏掉真内点，太大把外点也算进来。
hint.en: The more outliers, the smaller the chance that a round draws two inliers. δ depends only on the noise: too small misses true inliers, too large counts outliers in as well.

text.zh: δ 由三种比例共用。色带是与直线距离小于 δ 的范围；虚线是真实直线，圆圈标出抽中的两点
text.en: δ is shared by all three ratios. The band covers everything closer than δ to the line; the dashed line is the true line, and the circled points are the two drawn
